environment: Windows Sandbox (Portuguese Windows) with networking enabled; SYSTEM phase plus the operator's administrator session and a standard user created inside the Sandbox
scope: F5 part 5a (tamper-protection.md): restricted service permissions, in-service watchdog, scheduled watchdog task and tamper events

packages.build: tools/build-msi-fixtures.ps1 -Production and -Production -Next (no defines), WiX 5.0.2, agent and installer source at 4c4271b
packages.fault_injection_actions: absent in all three packages (CustomAction table checked inside Sandbox before install)

checks: upgrade from the previous release applies the restricted service permissions and the watchdog scheduled task
a standard user cannot stop, reconfigure or delete the service, edit agent.json or write to the program folder
an administrator cannot stop, reconfigure or delete the service
a deleted NRPT rule is recreated and reported
a changed browser policy is reapplied and reported
removed recovery actions and a reset service DACL are restored and reported
a deleted watchdog scheduled task is recreated and reported
a killed service is restarted by recovery and the unexpected exit is reported
a disabled and stopped service is started again by the scheduled watchdog and reported
upgrade to a later version works with the restricted permissions
removal deletes the scheduled task and restores NRPT rules, browser policies, trust and hosts

permissions.meaning: sc.exe exit code 5 is access denied; write probes 1 = denied

notes: Earlier attempts failed on harness defects only: a localized group name (Usuarios), cmd parsing 'echo key=5>>file' as a handle redirection, and Windows PowerShell 5.1 turning redirected native stderr into a terminating error
One attempt found an agent defect: the scheduled watchdog started the service before writing its event, and the service read pending events only at start. Fixed in 4c4271b with a native contract
Tampering was done with SYSTEM rights (the only account that can still change the service), which also covers an administrator who took ownership
